title: Module 4 Quiz: AI in Financial Services

questions.text: What is the primary benefit of using AI facial recognition and OCR for bank account onboarding?
options: It allows banks to charge higher fees.
It enables instant identity verification using a smartphone selfie and ID scan.
It replaces the need for any customer service.
questions.explanation: It allows instant identity verification via a smartphone selfie and ID scan.

questions.text: How does AI improve fraud detection compared to traditional rule‑based systems?
options: By blocking all international transactions automatically.
By requiring customers to call customer service for every purchase.
By learning a customer’s normal spending pattern and flagging deviations in real time.
By eliminating the need for any transaction monitoring.
questions.explanation: It learns a customer’s normal spending pattern and flags deviations in real time.

questions.text: True or false: AI personal finance tools should be evaluated for transaction fees, algorithm transparency, data privacy, and human oversight.
questions.explanation: These four criteria are essential for safe and effective use of AI finance tools.

questions.text: True or false: AI credit decisions rely solely on your monthly income to determine loan eligibility.
questions.explanation: AI considers multiple factors such as repayment history, debt, and cash flow, not just income.
